title: A noncommutative transfer principle
summary: We extend the generalised Calderon Transfer Principle as presented in \cite{dBL} to the setting of trace preserving group actions of $σ$-compact locally compact Hausdorff groups on semifinite von Neumann algebras $\M$. At its essence the transfer principle consists of showing that a large class of regular operators in the group context may be translated to operators in the algebra context by means of this group action.
